expectation: Nuclear TCF7 in a subset of naive/stem-like memory T cells (plus a few NK/ILC cells). It should show as discrete nuclear-sized dots inside CD3+ lymphoid aggregates and T-rich stroma. Epithelium should be mostly negative.
observed: A: punctate yellow cells cluster in dense immune regions of several cores and are sparse in epithelium. A few cores are uniformly hazy. B/C: mostly dim, with a few bright blobs. D: discrete but smeared cells. E: TCF7 sits within CD3-dense areas, with some CD3+ cells negative.
why: TCF7 cells follow CD3-rich aggregates and avoid epithelium, but contrast is low, with some haze and blobby speckle.
